description: Alphanumeric filtering terms used with the genomic feature collection root (`/features`). They are plain Beacon alphanumeric filters (id, operator, value) and do not have to correspond to a property of the feature schema. Filters apply on collection roots only, never on nested routes.

filteringTerms.description: One term per tissue / cell-type ontology id (for example `tissue.percentile:UBERON:0002107`). The value is the percentile (0-100) of the feature's expression among features within that tissue. `>= 0` selects features detected in the tissue, `>= 99` the top 1%. Operators `>=`, `>`, `<=`, `<`, `=`.
filteringTerms.label: Expression percentile within a tissue or cell type

filteringTerms.description: Feature median percentile in at least one matrix. Operator `>=`.
filteringTerms.label: Top expressed
